description: Updates No-API Server credentials/configuration with the exact WAPI credentials array for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true. Never returns passwords.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact credential/configuration change.

credentials.description: Exact WAPI ManagedServerCredentials[] array. Password values are accepted as input but never returned.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete credential/configuration consequences.

name: hgr_update_noapi_servers
title: Update Noapi Servers
